response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS pair_avg
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY mktnote
), above AS (
  SELECT p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND p.pair_avg > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS mean_pair_average_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_overall_average
FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite's GROUP BY treats NULL mktnote values as one group, as requested; AVG skips NULL net fee rates, and fees with no exactly matching order are excluded.
